_comment: Project identity that CITATION.cff cannot express. CFF 1.2.0 is a strict schema and
rejects unknown keys, so funding, the dataset licence, and the display forms of the
institution live here instead. Everything CFF DOES model (authors, ORCIDs, DOI, code
licence, repository) is read from CITATION.cff and must not be duplicated here.
Consumed by scripts/sync_brand_assets.py; run `just assets-sync` after editing.
institution: Institute of Environmental Sciences (CML), Leiden University

dataLicence.name: CC BY 4.0
dataLicence._comment: status is 'planned': no release has been published yet, and neither site may state the terms flat. See docs/src/content/docs/project/dataset.md, the canonical statement.

funding.sentence: Supported by the Leiden University Starter Fund, the Depack grant (Leiden University Fund), and Sectorplan Gelden, a research infrastructure fund of the Dutch government.
